text:
devin: FYI ran a perf pass on the 4k-seq LLM after yesterday's kernel selector tweak — started seeing OOM spikes in prod on p4d nodes. attaching quick profiler notes below. @sasha any ideas?

sasha: saw the trace — looks like Triton flash kernel requested a ~4.5GB workspace for attention at the hot shape, and our allocator fragmentation made it impossible to satisfy, so it OOM'd even though ~1GB was free in smaller contiguous blocks.

jon: short checklist: 1) cap per-kernel workspace (fraction + absolute), 2) prefer kernels with smaller max-alloc on memory-constrained runs, 3) add probe/warmup to choose kernel at first request.

devin: profiler excerpt (condensed):
```
[perf-bot] profile: model=my-4k-test, bs=2, seq=4096, heads=32, dim=4096
mem_before=20.3GB free_total=3.1GB
flash_triton: requested_workspace=4.5GB -> OOM
triton_fallback: requested_workspace=1.1GB -> success
latency: flash=22ms (fail), triton=28ms (ok)
```

perf-bot: summary metrics (last hour): 7 occurrances OOMs traced to workspace allocation, 92% resolved by immediate fallback to triton/cuBLASLt, 2.3% user-visible failures.

elaine: concrete mitigations that helped us on Dedicated:
- pooling allocator tuning: max_block=512MB, prefer_coalesce=true, split_threshold=64KB
- workspace sizing policy: per-kernel fraction (0.2 of free_mem) + per-kernel absolute cap (1GB for attention on p4d)
- dynamic probe: run a tiny warmup batch to call kernel->query_workspace_size() then lock kernel choice for that route

sasha: +1 on probe. also: add a graceful OOM policy: on OOM -> shrink_workspace_attempt -> retry -> if still OOM -> fallback kernel -> if still OOM -> evict LRU nonhot KV pages (if route allows) -> final fail. Implemented as state machine.

devin: can someone sketch the config we should expose to product for tuning? want to avoid too many knobs but need escape hatches.

jon: example yaml we used (short):
```
runtime:
  workspace_policy:
    per_kernel_fraction: 0.25   # cap workspace to 25% of free GPU mem for this kernel
    per_kernel_max_mb: 1024
    fallback_order: [flash_attention, triton, cublaslt]
    oom_mitigation: [shrink_then_retry, fallback, evict_kv]

allocator:
  type: pooled
  max_block_mb: 512
  prefer_coalesce: true
  split_threshold_kb: 64
```

elaine: also keep a small reserved pool (eg 512MB) for KV cache growth and tracing — reduces live eviction churn. and record a histogram of contiguous largest-free-chunk to track fragmentation trends.

devin: great. i'll open a small PR to add the probe + workspace_policy with sane defaults and we'll runtime-A/B it on a subset of nodes. thanks. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: created perf-issue #4521 for workspace OOM regression (linked traces + repro steps).
